change_contract.goal: Keep applying an inbound event when the downstream call fails.
acceptance_criteria: A transient downstream failure no longer drops the event.
A given delivery changes downstream state at most once.
non_goals: Change how events are rendered for operators.
preserved_behaviors: Events are applied in the order they were received.

data: Each delivery carries a stable delivery identifier.
operational: The upstream sender redelivers on any non-2xx reply.
